turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Hello, and I am sorry the print does not suit your wall. I can help with a return. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address the order was placed with.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Ysolde. I have filed a return request (R-1) for order SC-5211, the print Păunul de ceață, 40x50 cm. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the request and the refund, so it is not final yet. The return is under way only after approval, and I cannot confirm the refund amount.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: I will pay the return postage. Please file the return for the team to approve. I am not asking for a reprint.

Thank you. Your return request R-1 for order SC-5211 is already filed and waiting for staff approval, so I have not filed it a second time. You will pay the return postage, as the policy says. No reprint has been requested. Staff will confirm the return and the refund.
